name: code-viewer
description: Code Viewer for Claude Code: open the files and diffs of your session in a side pane, with tabs, fuzzy search and themeable syntax highlighting.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The color theme of the code pane.

highlighter.title: Highlighter
highlighter.description: theme: the mod's own themeable highlighter where it knows the language, Claude Code's elsewhere. engine: always Claude Code's (its colors are fixed).

wrapLines.title: Wrap long lines
wrapLines.description: Wrap lines wider than the pane instead of cutting them.

keywordColor.title: Keyword color
keywordColor.description: Overrides the theme: a hex color (#c678dd) or a color name. Empty keeps the theme's.

stringColor.title: String color
stringColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

commentColor.title: Comment color
commentColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

numberColor.title: Number and constant color
numberColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

functionColor.title: Function color
functionColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

typeColor.title: Type color
typeColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

propertyColor.title: Property and key color
propertyColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

lineNumberColor.title: Line number color
lineNumberColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty keeps the theme's.

backgroundColor.title: Pane background
backgroundColor.description: A color painted under the pane. Empty keeps the terminal's own background.

diffAddedColor.title: Added line background
diffAddedColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty follows your Claude Code theme.

diffRemovedColor.title: Removed line background
diffRemovedColor.description: Overrides the theme. Empty follows your Claude Code theme.
